title: Ask HN: How do you not take criticism of your work personally?
guide_zh: 工作被提改进意见时总觉得在否定自己，如何把反馈与个人价值分开？
author: molly0
excerpt: I’ve come to realize that I often take constructive criticisms personally. Everything from an unintentionally snarky comment in a PR I’ve made to someone highlight a mistake I’ve made that I probably couldn’t have known about. I see this as one of my major flaws and try hard to mask how I feel. But I just hope to learn to stop feeling bad for honest mistakes.

title: We should start to add “ai.txt” as we do for “robots.txt”
guide_zh: 作者提议像 robots.txt 一样为项目添加 ai.txt，并展示写入相关说明的尝试。
author: Jeannen
excerpt: I started to add an ai.txt to my projects. The file is just a basic text file with some useful info about the website like what it is about, when was it published, the author, etc etc. It can be great if the website somehow ends up in a training dataset (who knows), and it can be super helpful for AI website crawlers, instead of using thousands of tokens to know what your website is about, they can do it with just a few hundred.
